g.text: E17: six common-source FET rail disconnects; AUX-powered precision OV sensing and all-rail interlock. Source rails and protected outputs are distinct nets.

g.desc: E17: six common-source FET rail disconnects; AUX-powered precision OV sensing and all-rail interlock. Source rails and protected outputs are distinct nets.

g.text: VSONP grouped pads1=S(physical1..3),2=G(physical4),3=D(physical5..8/EP). Body diodes oppose. Gate/source reference floats with each common node.

g.desc: VSONP grouped pads1=S(physical1..3),2=G(physical4),3=D(physical5..8/EP). Body diodes oppose. Gate/source reference floats with each common node.

g.text: Any source OV/reference-window fault or POWER_RUN low disables all six drivers. Zero source voltage is allowed during startup; no protected-rail supply dependency.

g.desc: Any source OV/reference-window fault or POWER_RUN low disables all six drivers. Zero source voltage is allowed during startup; no protected-rail supply dependency.

g.text: Si8751 timing maxima use100pF load. Actual FET charge,bulk capacitors,MCAP currents,inrush,leakage,partial-power and fault-energy limits require qualification.
